[ASSISTANT_SAID] Brown algae can be caused by excess nutrients, insufficient water changes, inadequate lighting, high pH, and poor water circulation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to get rid of brown algae include increasing water changes (20-30% every week), monitoring feeding amounts, adjusting lighting, checking pH, increasing water circulation, using algae-controlling measures, and cleaning the glass.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should ensure they vary their neon tetras' diet and not overfeed them.
